payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 7. Calling a sign-flipping TTFT matrix a stable win

problem.statement: SM120 RMSNorm-MLP PDL Pitfalls -- 7. Calling a sign-flipping TTFT matrix a stable win

payload.attempted: One prompt length or one launch order shows a small no-PDL fusion win.
payload.lesson: If strict order-controlled TTFT flips sign, keep the route behind an experiment flag and do not default-enable it.

established_fact.mechanism: The saved traffic is small relative to full served TTFT, and order noise is comparable to the effect size.

payload.observed: Strict two-order averages changed sign by prompt length, with absolute deltas below a few tenths of a millisecond.
payload.root_cause: The saved traffic is small relative to full served TTFT, and order noise is comparable to the effect size.
